column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules (brief 15.7, ADR 0014). FAIL breaks the PR, WARN is reported,
# IGNORE only with a reason. Changing a line needs the owner (AGENTS.md: agents never dismiss
# a security finding themselves). Format: id<TAB>level<TAB>(name) reason

column3: (Vulnerable JS Library (Powered by Retire.js)) a JS library with known vulnerabilities
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag) no cookies are set; a cookie without HttpOnly would be new
(Cookie Without Secure Flag) no cookies are set; a cookie without Secure would be new
(Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion) script from another origin (CSP forbids it)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) Caddy sends X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
(Information Disclosure - Sensitive Information in URL) the gateway token must never be in a URL (ADR 0011)
(Information Disclosure - Sensitive Information in HTTP Referrer Header)
(HTTP Server Response Header) Caddy removes the Server header
(Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s)) no framework banners
(Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set) Caddy sends a strict CSP; the token in localStorage depends on it
(HTTP to HTTPS Insecure Transition in Form Post)
(HTTPS to HTTP Insecure Transition in Form Post)
(Cookie without SameSite Attribute) no cookies are set; a cookie without SameSite would be new
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration) the app sends no CORS headers
(Modern Web Application) informational: the app is a SPA by design; the scan uses the AJAX spider (-j)
(ZAP is Out of Date) the image is pinned by digest and updated by Renovate
(Non-Storable Content) informational: hashed assets are cacheable by design, /config.json is no-store by design
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing or Invalid) Caddy sends COOP/CORP/COEP (cross-origin isolation)
